sla_requirements: Throughput guarantee: sustained 18k tokens/sec aggregate (peak windows) with burst to 30k tokens/sec for 5 minutes
Latency SLOs: p50 < 60ms per-token, p95 < 220ms per-token for typical 4k-context inference; absolute tail protection for 16k context tests
Availability target: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated endpoints; clear credit schedule for SLA misses
Failover: automatic routing to private-Dedicated pool within same region under capacity pressure
capacity_plan: Target reserved footprint: 12 x H100-equivalent nodes for baseline; additional 6 nodes as warm pool for burst handling
Planning constraint: on-prem H100s will be used for non-sensitive batch jobs only; Dedicated pool must handle latency-sensitive chat and rerank workloads
Retention: KV cache retention across requests to reduce repeated compute for repeated prefixes
Quantization: willing to evaluate 4-bit quantized model variants to reduce per-token compute during high-cost periods
autoscaling_preferences: Scale-up policy: aggressive horizontal scale when CPU/GPU utilization > 65% sustained for 30s OR request queue depth > 50
Scale-down policy: conservative cooldown 10 minutes; prefer draining connections and keep warm pool at 30% of baseline
Warm pools: maintain 6 hot nodes ready with warmed KV caches for top-10 models; instant attach to endpoint for sub-1s scale-in latency
Queueing behavior: bounded queues per model with soft-priority for live chat traffic; backpressure to caller with retry hints (exponential backoff headers)
Autoscaler metrics: request latency histogram, KV cache hit rate, per-node token/sec, pending queue length
Throttling: prefer graceful shedding (rerank to cached candidate lists) before full reject; route overflow to a lower-cost model variant
poc_plan: Week 1: baseline throughput and latency profiling (3 model variants; 4k and 16k contexts)
Week 2: autoscaler tuning + warm-pool validation (synthetic spikes up to 2x peak)
Week 3: failure modes + SLA test (simulate node loss, cross-region failover), handoff to infra for ops runbook
Deliverables: capacity runbook, recommended reserved counts, SLA draft, cost/km estimates
